rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: Between 2014 and 2018, Item 17 adds a non-curable pre-opening default for failure to timely pay promissory-note amounts, stops stating the $10,000 Transfer Fee, and introduces mediation-before-arbitration and Code of Conduct peer-group arbitration, while also changing the illustrative renewal document list.
rows.reviewReason: The 2018 summary omits the personal guaranty example but retains 'e.g.' and 'etc.', so the actual renewal document set is not determinable from the supplied text. schema repair: same_concept_match conflicted with change_type; schema repaired in v4.3; verify before research use deterministic evidence check failed (old=failed, new=normalized_whitespace)

oldEvidence.quote: execute our then current form of franchise agreement and related documents (e g, personal guaranty, noncompetition agreement, etc )

In addition, the followmg pre-opemng defaults cannot be cured (i) failure of the Owner Manager to complete training to our satisfaction within 2 attempts and within 60 days after signing the Franchise Agreement, or (ii) your failure to commence operations within 90 days after signing the Franchise Agreement
You must be current on all your payments, pay us the $10,000Transfer Fee and execute a general release and subordination agreement.
Except for certain claims all disputes must be arbitrated in Arizona (except as otherwise disclosed in the State Specific Addenda. Exhibit "E" to this Disclosure Document)
All disputes must be litigated or arbitrated in Arizona (except as otherwise disclosed in the State Specific Addenda. Exhibit "E" to this Disclosure Document and subject to state law)

newEvidence.quote: execute our then current form of franchise agreement and related documents (e.g., Franchise Owner Agreement, noncompetition agreement, etc.)

In addition, the following pre-opening defaults cannot be cured: (i) failure of the Owner Manager to complete training to our satisfaction within 2 attempts and within 60 days after signing the Franchise Agreement; (ii) your failure to commence operations within 90 days after signing the Franchise Agreement; or (iii) your failure to timely pay any amounts due to us under any promissory note.
You must be current on all your payments, pay us the Transfer Fee and execute a general release and subordination agreement.

Except for certain claims, all disputes must be arbitrated in Arizona if not first resolved through mediation (except as otherwise disclosed in the State Specific Addenda, Exhibit “E” to this Disclosure Document).
All disputes must be mediated, litigated or arbitrated in Arizona (except as otherwise disclosed in the State Specific Addenda, Exhibit “E” to this Disclosure Document and subject to state law).
All Code of Conduct disputes are subject to arbitration which may be conducted by a franchisee peer group.

rows.inferenceLimit: Cannot conclude that the personal guaranty was removed or that the Franchise Owner Agreement was newly required, because the list is illustrative and non-exhaustive. Do not infer that any default or termination occurred; only that the 2018 FDD discloses an additional non-curable pre-opening default. Do not infer the actual 2018 Transfer Fee amount or whether the fee increased, decreased, or remained $10,000; only that the amount is no longer disclosed. Do not infer that mediation was used or resolved any dispute; only that the FDD now discloses mediation as a prerequisite to arbitration. Do not infer how peer-group arbitration would be conducted, whether it replaces the Arizona venue, or that any Code of Conduct dispute occurred.
